title: HUB CELTIC FIRE (Celtic Folk × Hardstyle × Trad Rave) [150]
style: Celtic folk meets hardstyle and trad rave, 150 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave Irish Gaelic + Scots Gaelic + te reo Maori, tin whistle and low whistle melody runs, fiddle reels, Uilleann pipes drone and chanter, bodhran drum patterns, hardstyle reverse bass kick pattern, distorted festival kick, deep sub bass, anthemic synth lead, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, bonfire-clan-gathering ecstatic mood, sidechain pumping pads to kick, festival mainstage 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Uilleann pipe drone, distant bodhran, tin whistle motif)
(HUB... cel... tic... fi... re...)
(t... ei... ne... t... ei... ne...)
(a... hi... ka... a... hi... ka...)

[Build]
(bodhran roll locks in, fiddle reel climbs, sub slides up)
HUB! CEL — TIC! FI — RE!
TEI — NE! TEI — NE!
A — HI — KA!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(snare roll, pipe chanter rises)

[Drop 1]
(hardstyle reverse bass, festival kick, fiddle lead over top)
FI — RE!
GA — THER!
FLA — ME!
SIG — NAL!
(chop stack +7) sea-sea-tha-tha / āe-āe-sea-sea
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(tin whistle solo phrase, bodhran pocket, chops trade)
(cá bhfuil?) (càit?) (kei hea?)
(anseo!) (an seo!) (konei!)
(téigh!) (rach!) (haere!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE FLAME —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to Uilleann pipes + low whistle alone, no kick)
(whispered) hub... celtic... fire...
(soft) teine... teine...
(soft) ahi ka... ahi ka...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(bodhran roll builds, hardstyle kick returns)

[Drop 2]
(double-time hardstyle, full Celtic stack peak, fiddle doubled)
HUB — CEL — TIC — FI — RE! (sea sea sea!)
GA — THER! (téigh! rach! haere!)
FLA — ME! (āe āe āe!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(hardstyle fades, fiddle resolves, pipes hold drone)
(hub... celtic... fire...)
(teine... ahi ka...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(Uilleann drone holds long, fade to silence)
